name: Vernal-Barrow

civilization.name: Kethrim Ascendancy
civilization.notes: Long dead; only ruins and orbital debris remain of a civilization that flourished before the world turned hostile.

description: Sand owns this world, in colors from bone-white to burnt sienna, migrating with the seasons before a patient wind. Where the gusts strip it away, tectonic rift valleys emerge like the bones of the planet.
Toxic air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
The ruins predate every charted civilization, and whatever built the buried megastructure left in a hurry. Doors seal from the outside. Nobody has explained why.
Survey contracts pay double for reasons nobody writes down. Veterans read the fine print, then read the survivors.
